{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Bread|Bread]]

==Ingredients==
* 750 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] [[Cookbook:Spelt|spelt flour]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* 1 tsp white granulated [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
* 1 sachet (7 g) dried [[Cookbook:Yeast|yeast]]
* 2 ½ [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] (40 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]]) [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]]
* 500 ml lukewarm water

==Procedure==
# Combine the flour, salt, sugar and yeast.
# To the dry ingredients, add the oil and enough water to make a firm [[Cookbook:Dough|dough]].
# [[Cookbook:Kneading|Knead]] the dough for about 10 minutes.
# Place in a greased 1 kg [[Cookbook:Loaf Pan|loaf tin]], cover and leave it in a warm place until doubled in size.
# Uncover and [[Cookbook:Baking|bake]] in a preheated [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] at 200°C for about 35 minutes. The bread is cooked when it makes a hollow sound when tapped on the bottom.

==Notes, tips, and variations==
* If shaped into a round and placed on a greased [[Cookbook:Baking Sheet|baking tray]], you can make a country style loaf.
